page.overview:
Who is Diego Brando?

This Diego is brought to the "root world" with the Saint's Corpse from a parallel world by President Funny Valentine after the death of the original Diego. He is a racer from a similar Steel Ball Run Race happening in a parallel world. As a final precaution, Valentine employed this Diego to steal back the Saint's Corpse and deliver it in his place, should he be defeated by Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli. After stealing the Corpse, Alternate Diego ambushes Johnny in the final stage of the "root world" Steel Ball Run Race, attempting to tie up the last loose end in his way.

He is a Stand User like his original counterpart, but due to the Saint's Corpse only existing in the "root world", he was never forced to wield Scary Monsters. Instead, Alternate Diego possesses his true stand, the timestopping THE WORLD.

The second Diego is virtually identical in appearance to the first. He is a young man of below-average height and slim to medium build. He has light hair, dark eyebrows, and light, bold eyes.

He commonly wears an with the letters "D", "I", and "O" mounted on bending pins emerging from a small ribbon tied at its front, a turtleneck jumper patterned with a diagonal grid, light, mid-forearm-length gloves, light, wide-legged , and tall, dark .
